changeSet.sql:
create table loan_clients( loan_client_id bigint, client_number varchar(20) not null , constraint pk_loan_clients primary key (loan_client_id) ); create sequence sq_loan_clients;
create table loans( loan_id bigint, loan_client_id bigint, loan_amount int not null , interest_rate decimal(9,2) not null , days_past_due int, status char not null, agreement_number varchar(20) not null, investment_number varchar(20) not null, investment_amount decimal(9,2) not null, investment_date date not null , returned_amount decimal(9,2) not null, paid_interest decimal(9,2) not null, paid_penalty decimal(9,2) not null, remaining_installments int, remaining_installment_amount decimal(9,2), expected_interest_amount decimal(9,2), next_installment_date date, sellable boolean, current_value decimal(9,2), discount_amount decimal(9,2), paid_at date, paid_amount decimal(9,2), constraint pk_loans primary key (loan_id), constraint fk_loans_loan_client foreign key (loan_client_id) references loan_clients(loan_client_id) ); create sequence sq_loans;
